# Goody — account brief

## Who

Goody is a gifting platform for sending personal and business gifts without needing an address ([source](https://ongoody.com/)). Its GitHub org is Goody at ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody)).

## Production Expo signals

- eas.json in ongoody/goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- react-native ~0.73.6 in ongoody/goody-app/package.json ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json))
- CI workflows in ongoody/goody-app ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- 11 public repos and 64 followers on github.com/ongoody ([source](https://github.com/ongoody))
- ongoody/goody-app last pushed 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app))
- 5,400 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157))
- 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157))

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@ongoody-maintainer-1), top contributor to ongoody/goody-app with 96 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Goody" and website https://ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)). No role or location listed.
- Maintainer Two (@ongoody-maintainer-2), top contributor to ongoody/goody-app with 40 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Goody" and website https://ongoody.com ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-2)). No role or location listed.
- @ongoody-maintainer-3, top contributor to ongoody/goody-app with 12 commits ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-3)). The profile record lists no company, location, or bio.

## Why now

goody-app last pushed 2026-07-29 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app)) and the store listing shows 4 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). The app is on react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

You have 96 commits in goody-app, which builds through EAS on React Native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/ongoody-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/blob/main/package.json)). The repo also has its own CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/ongoody/goody-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and the store listing shows 4 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goody-send-a-gift/id1524669157)). When you ship a fix, does it go out over the air on a channel, or does it wait for one of those store releases?
